source_chain_audit.scope: Reviewed the DGI compilation effective 2002-01-01; the 2003 Finance Law Article 9 list of amended TVA articles; the 2004 and 2005 Official Gazette amendments; the DGI CGI 2014 reference table; and repository legal-text hits for Loi n° 30-85 and its promulgating Dahir. No additional non-finance Article 15 amendment was identified in the available sources.

reviewed_sources.title: Loi de finances n° 45-02, Article 9, amendments to Loi n° 30-85
reviewed_sources.finding: The visually checked list in Article 9 names Articles 7, 31, 34, 35, 43, 46 and 60 of Loi n° 30-85; it does not name Article 15. This checks the 2003 Finance Law only.
reviewed_sources.verified_quote:
Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée

promulguée par le dahir n° 1-85-347 du 7 rabii II 1406 (20 décembre 1985),
sont modifiées et complétées comme suit :

reviewed_sources.title: Code général des impôts 2014, DGI amendment-reference table
reviewed_sources.finding: The DGI reference table lists the 2002 Finance Law Article 9, 2003 Finance Law Article 9, 2004 Finance Law Article 12, and 2005 Finance Law Article 15 among the TVA-related references. It also lists a separate 2005 procedures-law amendment and administrative orders; the table is a bibliographic cross-check, not a complete negative audit.

source_chain_audit.limitation: The repository does not contain a complete run of all Gazette issues for 2002–2005, so the search cannot prove an exhaustive negative. The 2002 DGI compilation is a third-party-hosted text-layer transcription, not a locally pinned DGI/SGG PDF. Treat these as well-supported reconstructed snapshots, not an official DGI-published consolidation or an exhaustive clause-by-clause legal negative.

documented_changes: Water delivery clause explicitly includes sanitation services.
Fluid edible oils move from the 7% list to the 10% list.
The animal-feed clause adds oilseed cakes used to manufacture feed.
The economic-car clause adds assembly services, and its formalities condition is updated to include those services.
